# Ulta Beauty

> Ulta Beauty is a comprehensive online beauty retailer offering makeup, skincare, fragrance, haircare, and beauty products from leading brands with advanced product filtering and a rewards program.

Ulta Beauty serves as a one-stop destination for beauty shopping, featuring thousands of products across multiple categories with sophisticated filtering options for skin type, coverage, finish, and clean beauty attributes. The platform carries premium and accessible brands including Estée Lauder, Benefit Cosmetics, Redken, OLAPLEX, and emerging beauty lines.

## Key Topics

- Makeup shopping
- Face makeup
- Lip products
- Skin type filters
- Coverage options
- Product catalog
- Beauty retail
- Cruelty-free beauty
- SPF protection
- Clean beauty
- Product filters
- Foundation
- Concealer
- Setting spray
- Rewards program

## Shopping & Main Categories

- [Ulta Beauty Homepage](https://www.ulta.com): Main Ulta Beauty homepage featuring makeup, skincare, fragrance, haircare and rewards program.
- [Makeup & Nail Products](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup): Main makeup and nail products shopping category at Ulta Beauty.
- [Lips - Makeup](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/lips): Lip makeup products with 1116 items and multiple subcategories.

## Face Makeup Products

- [Face - Makeup](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/face): Face makeup product subcategory with 1694 items and filtering options.
- [Foundation](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/face/foundation): Foundation products with coverage and skin type filter options.
- [Concealer](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/face/concealer): Concealer products with coverage and form type filtering options.
- [Face Primer](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/face/face-primer): Face primer products with skin type and finish option filters.
- [Blush](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/face/blush): Blush products with form, color, and finish filtering options.
- [Bronzer](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/face/bronzer): Bronzer products with formula and cosmetic filtering options.
- [Highlighter](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/face/highlighter): Highlighter products with multiple filtering and customization options.
- [Setting Spray & Powder](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/face/setting-spray-powder): Setting spray and powder products with finish and clean beauty filters.

## Specialized Face Products

- [BB & CC Creams](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/face/bb-cc-creams): BB and CC cream products with SPF protection and coverage filters.
- [Tinted Moisturizer](https://www.ulta.com/shop/skin-care/moisturizers/tinted-moisturizer): Tinted moisturizer skincare products with SPF and skin type filters.
- [Contouring](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/face/contouring): Contouring products including cruelty-free and vegan options.
- [Color Correcting](https://www.ulta.com/shop/makeup/face/color-correcting): Color correcting makeup with clean beauty and cruelty-free filters.

## Skincare & Support

- [Makeup Remover](https://www.ulta.com/shop/skin-care/cleansers/makeup-remover): Makeup remover skincare products with skin type and concern filters.
